title: Sculpture of Chanakya with Chandragupta Maurya
description: Modern sculpture made from waste metal at Shaheedi Park, Delhi, photographed on 24 August 2024. An artistic interpretation of Chanakya and Chandragupta, not a Mauryan-period portrait.
